entity: Reliant Care Management's Missouri nursing homes: staffing hours and harm citations vs other Missouri for-profit homes
what_we_add: the chain-level numbers: 2.16 vs 3.35 nurse hours, 4.67 vs 1.23 harm citations per 100 beds (3.8x), fines 4.3x; no source has the citation or fine comparison
why: KCUR/Missouri Independent names Reliant Care and reports the low-staffing finding in the same direction (16 homes under 2 hours daily). Tallgrass calls it the lowest-rated chain it has seen. Nobody has our harm-citation or fine ratios. ProPublica's 34 facilities covers Kansas too, so no contradiction with our 30 Missouri homes.
